description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ScreenPermissionServiceTest' for testing the 'ScreenPermissionService' class in the 'OrangeHRM' system. It includes setup code, mock dependencies, and multiple test cases verifying the behavior of permission retrieval based on user roles, screen definitions, and permissions data, as well as retrieving screen details.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the behavior of 'ScreenPermissionService' related to permission retrieval and screen fetching.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of 'ScreenPermissionService'.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithNoScreen
methods.description: Tests the scenario where no permissions are found and no screen is defined, expecting default resource permissions allowing all actions.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithScreenDefined
methods.description: Tests the case where no permissions are returned but a screen is defined, expecting resource permissions with no access.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of permissions when a single permission record exists for a user role.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsTwo
methods.description: Tests retrieval of permissions with multiple roles, expecting proper merge of permissions.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsMany
methods.description: Tests retrieval with multiple roles and multiple permission entries, verifying correct permission aggregation.

methods.name: testGetScreen
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a screen object given a module and action.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to assert that a given 'ResourcePermission' object has the expected permissions for read, create, update, and delete.
